Here is the part-of-speech analysis for the sentence: "While I was walking through the park, I stumbled upon an old, mysterious book that was hidden beneath a pile of leaves."

**Sentence Breakdown:**

1.  **While** – Subordinating Conjunction (introduces the dependent clause)
2.  **I** – Pronoun (Subject of the dependent clause)
3.  **was** – Verb (Auxiliary/Helping verb, past tense)
4.  **walking** – Verb (Present participle, main verb of the dependent clause)
5.  **through** – Preposition
6.  **the** – Determiner (Article)
7.  **park** – Noun (Object of the preposition "through")
8.  **,** – Punctuation
9.  **I** – Pronoun (Subject of the independent clause)
10. **stumbled** – Verb (Main verb, past tense)
11. **upon** – Preposition
12. **an** – Determiner (Article)
13. **old** – Adjective
14. **,** – Punctuation
15. **mysterious** – Adjective
16. **book** – Noun (Object of the preposition "upon")
17. **that** – Relative Pronoun (Subject of the relative clause)
18. **was** – Verb (Auxiliary/Helping verb, past tense)
19. **hidden** – Verb (Past participle, passive voice)
20. **beneath** – Preposition
21. **a** – Determiner (Article)
22. **pile** – Noun (Object of the preposition "beneath")
23. **of** – Preposition
24. **leaves** – Noun (Object of the preposition "of")
25. **.** – Punctuation
